{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Remove rows where biomarker_baseline is -999 (QC failure)
df_clean = df[df["biomarker_baseline"] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq (descending), then drop duplicates on patient_id
df_clean = df_clean.sort_values(by=["patient_id", "sample_seq"], ascending=[True, False])
df_clean = df_clean.drop_duplicates(subset="patient_id", keep="first")

# Step 3: Filter for patients with SEVERE disease
df_severe = df_clean[df_clean["severity"] == "severe"]

# Step 4: Compute the mean of biomarker_baseline
mean_baseline_severe = df_severe["biomarker_baseline"].mean()

print(f'Number of severe patients after cleaning: {len(df_severe)}')
print(f'Mean baseline biomarker (ng/mL) among severe patients: {mean_baseline_severe:.2f}')"}
